items.headline: Inside Gunner Stockton's record-setting performance
items.description: Georgia quarterback Gunner Stockton threw five touchdown passes, tying a school record as they defeated Western Kentucky 70-20.

items.headline: Highlight: Gunner Stockton ties Georgia record with 5 TD passes in rout
items.description: Stockton throws five touchdown passes to tie a Georgia single-game record as the No. 2 Bulldogs roll past Western Kentucky, 70-20.

items.headline: Kirby Smart reveals his message to Georgia after historic win
items.description: After the Bulldogs score 70 points for the first time in 32 years, Smart discusses how he wants the backups to improve and be ready when their names are called.

items.headline: Nate Frazier Jr. portrays the depth No. 2 Georgia possesses
items.description: After being a part of a dominating 70-20 win over Western Kentucky, Frazier Jr. speaks highly on the Bulldogs' talent throughout the depth chart.
